english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for dividing or sharing something among people.
Use this when dividing food, money, or another share among people.

examples.english: We split this sum of money into three shares.
examples.traditional: 我哋將呢筆錢分咗三份。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 ni1 bat1 cin2 fan1 zo2 saam1 fan6

examples.english: The four of us will divide the bill tonight.
examples.traditional: 今晚張單我哋四個人分啦。
examples.jyutping: gam1 maan5 zoeng1 daan1 ngo5 dei6 sei3 go3 jan4 fan1 laa1
